# Test data

Source: 国土地理院ベクトルタイル提供実験
https://github.com/gsi-cyberjapan/gsimaps-vector-experiment

Downloaded 2026-09-06 for offline conversion/regression tests:

- `gsi-ebina-14.pbf`: https://cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp/xyz/experimental_bvmap/14/14536/6465.pbf
- `gsi-ebina-11.pbf`: https://cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp/xyz/experimental_bvmap/11/1817/808.pbf

These two fixture tiles do not constitute complete geographic coverage and must not be published as a production dataset. Extracted records are generated by this repository; the original files are unmodified.
- `gsi-tokyo-14.pbf`: https://cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp/xyz/experimental_bvmap/14/14552/6451.pbf
# OSM Washington fixture

`osm-washington.pbf` contains OpenStreetMap stations, motorway exits/ways, and
tourist attractions within 1,500 m of Washington Union Station. Retrieved via
Overpass on 2026-09-06, including referenced nodes/ways; contributor metadata
was removed with `osmium cat -f pbf,add_metadata=false`.

© OpenStreetMap contributors. This fixture is distributed under ODbL 1.0:
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

The OSM integration test adds **synthetic** administrative polygons solely for
deterministic containment tests. Those polygons are not real US boundaries,
and no fixture output is used by the production OSM workflow.
